title: CORE-01 System Formation: reusable capability contracts + multi-track workflow composition
purpose: Prove multiple unrelated workflows can share Locaily capabilities: verified repository baseline, reusable core capability tracks, multi-track composition, and the Repo Review proof workflow.

included: Capability contracts and registry with honest capability statuses.
Reusable core tracks: classify, summarize, extract, validate, prioritize, and transform.
Multi-track composition with schema validation, topological ordering, cross-track inputs, and failure modes.
Repo Review, Text QA, Document Review, and Content OS workflow classes.
Lighthouse behavioral-parity evidence and fail-closed OCR behavior.
Deterministic transform.map tooling and publish-preparation validation gates.
Lifecycle resume correction and regression coverage for the completed system.
excluded: A fifth workflow or action-items triage.
OCR adapter implementation or new external dependencies.
Benchmark qualification beyond the CORE-01 proof scope.
Automatic harness control, transcript capture, or mutating adapter actions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Capability and workflow contracts validate and the registry exposes honest reusable capability statuses.
Repo Review, Text QA, Document Review, and Content OS compose shared tracks with deterministic ordering and explicit failure behavior.
Shared core tracks reproduce Lighthouse behavior and are reused across independent workflow classes without domain contamination.
Deterministic transform.map and validation-gated publish preparation produce incomplete packages with ready=false instead of silently publishing.
Lifecycle resume behavior reopens active milestone sessions correctly after closeout.
The required CORE-01 suites and repository full suite pass from a committed clean state.
